channel.title: The Grant Desk - added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: added in last 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 15 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: NBER i3: Open Data Fellows Program 2027
item.description: National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER), Innovation Information Initiative (i3) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 1,500 per fellow, at least five fellowships, plus travel reimbursement to present at the i3 Technical Working Group meeting in December 2027. No application fee.

item.title: Netherland-America Foundation: Cultural Grant Program (1 November 2026 Cut-Off)
item.description: The Netherland-America Foundation (NAF) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Typically up to USD 5,000 per project, depending on scope and impact; higher amounts possible depending on available budget. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Museum: BRAIN Programmatic Open Call (public programs)
item.description: MIT Museum · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Up to USD 1,000 total per selected program, covering all costs including speaker and performer fees, travel, materials and equipment rental; proposals using external funding or smaller budgets welcome. The Museum sets ticket prices and keeps ticket revenue. No application fee.

item.title: Shape Arts: Emergent Residency 2026/27 (Tate St Ives / Porthmeor Studios)
item.description: Shape Arts, with Tate St Ives · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · GBP 3,000 bursary for the selected residency artist (restricted to artists living or working in Cornwall, Devon or Somerset). Disabled artists in the rest of the UK can join the shortlisted cohort, which brings mentoring and profile but no stated bursary. No application fee.

item.title: Pivotal Research Fellowship (2027 Q1)
item.description: Pivotal Research · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · £15,000 to £18,000 stipend (£18,000 for senior fellows, e.g. PhD, industry track record or strong publications) + travel to and from London + £1,800/month housing for non-London fellows + weekday lunch and dinner + compute.

item.title: Generator Residency (Kairos x Constellation, Winter 2027)
item.description: Kairos and Constellation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 8,500 per month stipend (some Embedded track residents employed at a roughly equivalent salary), plus travel to and from Berkeley. No application fee.

item.title: Alpaca Festival 2027: Open Call for Pattern-Based Performances, Workshops and Talks (Sheffield, UK)
item.description: Pattern Club (Alpaca Festival) · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Performances: artist fee plus national travel expenses. Workshops: artist fee, materials expenses and national travel expenses. Fee amounts are not yet confirmed (tight budget); additional costs may be covered on request. International travel is not covered beyond a small European train budget. Conference talks: no fee or expenses, in-person speakers get a free festival weekend pass and lunch on 6 and 7 May. No application fee.

item.title: Playful Obscura 2027: Arthouse Games Residency Africa (Addis Ababa, Goethe-Institut and A MAZE.)
item.description: Goethe-Institut Addis Abeba, with Creative HUB Ethiopia, A MAZE., British Council and Alliance Ethio-Francaise · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · Three-week funded residency hosting two artists at a time. 2027 financial terms were not published in the call excerpt we could verify; the 2026 Accra edition provided accommodation, a production budget of up to EUR 1,000 and a EUR 300 stipend. No application fee.

item.title: Follow Fluxus: After Fluxus Scholarship 2026/27 (EUR 10,000, 3-month studio and exhibition, Wiesbaden)
item.description: Nassauischer Kunstverein Wiesbaden, with the City of Wiesbaden · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 grant plus a rent-free 70.88 sqm live/work studio at the Kunsthaus Wiesbaden for three months and a follow-up exhibition at the Nassauischer Kunstverein. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP: Ukraine Solidarity Residencies Programme 2027 (Finland)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme) and partner residencies · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,200 per month (EUR 1,200 to 3,600 depending on residency length), plus free living and working space, one return trip from the artist's home, and a small access budget for disabled artists. No application fee.

item.title: Inciter Art (Fractured Atlas): quarterly open call for essays, 'tending to the hearth' (USD 750 stipend)
item.description: Fractured Atlas (Inciter Art) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · USD 750 stipend per selected writer, paid by ACH deposit or check once the first draft is finished (a W-9 form is required). No submission fee.

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: EMMA Kreativzentrum Pforzheim: Designers in Residence 2027 (EUR 1,000/month, 3 months)
item.description: EMMA Kreativzentrum Pforzheim (City of Pforzheim), with Pforzheim University and Design Center Baden-Wuerttemberg · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 1,000 per month (EUR 3,000 over the residency), plus material costs covered, free accommodation and reimbursed travel. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: HIAP x Sumud: Residency for Palestinian Artists in Helsinki, Spring 2027 (EUR 3,600 working grant)
item.description: HIAP Helsinki International Artist Programme, with Sumud - The Finnish Palestine Network · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 3,600 working grant, a free 63 sqm live/work studio, one return trip, and a visa budget covering application fees and visa-office travel. No application fee.

item.title: Kunstpunt Groningen: Open Call Tschumi Pavilion (Hellend Vlak 2027)
item.description: Kunstpunt Groningen · deadline 04 Nov 2026 · Up to three shortlisted artists receive EUR 1,500 (excl. VAT) each for a preliminary design; the selected artist receives a EUR 17,000 project budget, including their fee. No application fee.

item.title: VIA Art Fund: Artistic Production Grant (Spring 2027 cycle)
item.description: VIA Art Fund · deadline 05 Nov 2026 · $25,000 to $100,000 per project

item.title: Realities in Transition RiT2 Open Call #3: Uncharted Grounds, a VRChat world residency with L.E.V. Festival (EUR 10,000 fee plus up to EUR 15,000 production)
item.description: Realities in Transition (RiT2, Creative Europe), with L.E.V. Festival · deadline 06 Nov 2026 · EUR 10,000 gross artist fee per selected artist (paid in three instalments) plus up to EUR 15,000 gross production budget shared among the team. No travel or accommodation included. No application fee mentioned.

item.title: Coding it Forward: Winter Fellowship 2027 (US civic tech placements)
item.description: Coding it Forward · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Paid full-time job placement: USD 20 per hour for applicants with a Bachelor's degree, USD 25 per hour for applicants pursuing or holding a graduate degree (Master's or PhD), at 40 hours per week for ten weeks (roughly USD 8,000 to 10,000 in total). Pay rates and work dates are non-negotiable. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic STEM Fellows Program 2027 (four-month AI-for-science fellowship, January to May 2027)
item.description: Anthropic · deadline 28 Oct 2026 · USD 100,000 to 167,000 for the four-month fellowship (equivalent to USD 300,000 to 500,000 annualised), plus benefits; fellows are engaged through an employer of record on a fixed-term contract. No application fee.

item.title: LA Department of Cultural Affairs: NEAR + CO-UP Artist Residency Grants 2027-28
item.description: City of Los Angeles Department of Cultural Affairs (DCA) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · NEAR grants of USD 12,000 for individual artists; CO-UP grants of USD 15,000 for collaborations between social-justice nonprofits and artists. No application fee.

item.title: Frame Contemporary Art Finland: Mobility and Production Grants (October 2026 round)
item.description: Frame Contemporary Art Finland · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Mobility grants EUR 250 to 5,000; production grants EUR 2,500 to 8,000. No application fee.

item.title: Foresight Institute: AI for Science and Safety Nodes RFP 2026 (Local Compute; Coordination and Accountability; AI-first Science)
item.description: Foresight Institute · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · Grants typically USD 30,000 to 100,000 (smaller awards for the Human Empowerment and AI Insurance and Open Governance areas, larger for the rest; bigger amounts possible for the right project), usually paid as one lump sum, with up to 10 percent overhead. Optional office space in San Francisco or Berlin and access to private compute clusters. No application fee.

item.title: Processing Foundation Fellowship 2027
item.description: Processing Foundation · deadline 01 Nov 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend over the 8-month fellowship, plus open-source software mentorship, cohort collaboration, professional development and public presentation opportunities. No application fee.

item.title: Fonds Soziokultur: General Project Funding, November 2026 round (Allgemeine Projektfoerderung)
item.description: Fonds Soziokultur · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · EUR 5,000 to EUR 30,000 per project, covering at most 80 percent of the total project budget. No application fee.

item.title: MIT Solve: 2027 Global Challenges
item.description: MIT Solve (Massachusetts Institute of Technology) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Every selected Solver team receives a USD 10,000 grant funded by Solve, plus access to a pool of over USD 1 million in prize funding at selection and additional funding opportunities throughout the program. Sponsor prizes range from USD 100,000 to 200,000, including the AI for Humanity Prize (up to USD 150,000, Patrick J. McGovern Foundation), the Collegium Prize for Innovation (USD 100,000), the Citizens Workforce Innovation Prize (USD 100,000), the Crescent Enterprises AI for Social Innovation Prize (USD 100,000) and the Seeding the Future Prize (USD 150,000). No application fee.

item.title: Lendhauer: Urban Ecologies - Coexistence and Control (Lendhafen, Klagenfurt 2027)
item.description: Lendhauer (Klagenfurt, Austria) · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Artist fee up to EUR 2,500 gross, production costs up to EUR 4,000 gross (depending on project scope), and travel expenses up to EUR 1,000. No application fee.

item.title: Netherlands Embassy in Brussels: Open Call for Cultural Project Support
item.description: Embassy of the Kingdom of the Netherlands in Brussels · deadline 03 Nov 2026 · Up to EUR 5,000 per project.

item.title: Tate x Delfina Foundation: Brooks International Fellowship Programme 2027 (London)
item.description: Tate and Delfina Foundation · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · Non-salaried but fully supported: return economy-class flight, UK airport transfers, visa fee reimbursement and visa support via Delfina Foundation, a living allowance bursary of GBP 40 per day, a London Underground and bus travel pass, a single bedroom at Delfina Foundation with shared facilities, and travel to other Tate galleries and UK/European cultural institutions. The Leonora Carrington fellowship adds a research resource allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Creative Industries Fund NL: Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
item.description: Creative Industries Fund NL (Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie), with Videotage · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · One residency grant: EUR 5,000 for a two-month work period or EUR 6,500 for three months, covering travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Housing, work space, Videotage guidance and production costs are paid by the Fund directly to Videotage on top of the grant; accommodation is arranged by Videotage. No application fee.

item.title: HIAP: Learning Materials International Artist Residency 2027 (Suomenlinna, Helsinki)
item.description: HIAP (Helsinki International Artist Programme), with Kone Foundation · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · Working grant of EUR 1,350 per month (EUR 4,050 total for 90 days) via Kone Foundation, material budget up to EUR 750, access budget up to EUR 1,000, one return trip covered (slow travel encouraged), plus accommodation and workspace. For collectives, the working grant can be paid to one individual only and there is no additional travel budget.

item.title: Invisible Cartographies: Residency for Neurodivergent Artists (Buinho, Portugal)
item.description: Buinho Creative Hub (Creative Europe project Invisible Cartographies) · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,200 artist fee for the six weeks, free accommodation for the full period, travel budget up to EUR 300, plus a production budget and FabLab access. Meals not included. No application fee.

item.title: OASis Bom Dia Residency 2027 at Cultivamos Cultura (Sao Luis, Portugal)
item.description: Cultivamos Cultura (European OASis project) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · EUR 1,300 project fee, travel budget up to EUR 500, production and material expenses up to EUR 1,600 (pre-approved), food per diem, plus free accommodation in a private room in a shared farmhouse and access to a workspace or studio and all Cultivamos Cultura spaces and resources.

item.title: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab: Visiting Fellowships 2027 (Leuven)
item.description: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 per month for three months, covering accommodation and living costs, plus office space, library access and KU Leuven facilities. Five fellowships. No application fee.

item.title: EU CERV: European Remembrance 2026-27 (CERV-2026-CITIZENS-REM)
item.description: European Commission / EACEA (Citizens, Equality, Rights and Values Programme) · deadline 24 Feb 2027 · EUR 50,000 to EUR 500,000 per project, from an estimated call budget of EUR 28 million (EUR 14M Holocaust remembrance of Jewish victims; EUR 5M genocide, war crimes and crimes against humanity incl. Roma and LGBTIQ+ victims; EUR 5M colonialism, slavery and migration; EUR 4M democratic transitions). No application fee.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: Propuestas VEGAP 2026: XXX Call for Visual Creation Grants
item.description: VEGAP (Visual Entidad de Gestion de Artistas Plasticos), Fondo Asistencial y Cultural · deadline 26 Oct 2026 · EUR 100,000 total: 20 grants of EUR 5,000 each. No application fee.

item.title: Finnish Cultural Foundation: October Round 2026 (all fields of art and science)
item.description: Finnish Cultural Foundation (Suomen Kulttuurirahasto) · deadline 30 Oct 2026 · Around EUR 49 million awarded annually across roughly 2,100 grants; recent October rounds have averaged over 450 working and project grants covering one or more years, with working grants extending up to four years. No application fee.
